checked_items.zh: 全树核对凭据读写调用（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 系列命中 40 余处）：所有 credentials.set / credentials.unset 均位于各 IM 渠道控制器，用于把机器人凭据（AppSecret、BotToken、ClientSecret、Token）写入宿主凭据存储或清除，属正常的凭据管理；src 中不存在任何 credentials.get / credentials.describe 回读调用，无凭据读取后外发的路径。
checked_items.en: Full-tree check of credential read/write calls (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 series: 40+ hits): all credentials.set / credentials.unset are located in the IM channel controllers and are used to write bot credentials (AppSecret, BotToken, ClientSecret, Token) into the host credential store or to clear them—normal credential management; no credentials.get / credentials.describe read-back calls exist in src, leaving no path for reading credentials and exfiltrating them.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感文件路径（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等）与凭据枚举类命令（批量搜 key、遍历目录找密钥），均未发现。飞书渠道通过 /usr/bin/security 读取 macOS 钥匙串（见 DG-D3 裁决），参数固定、属用户自配凭据来源。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive file paths (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.) and credential-enumeration commands (bulk key search, directory traversal for keys): none found. The Feishu channel reads the macOS keychain via /usr/bin/security (see DG-D3 ruling); arguments are fixed and it is a user-configured credential source.

checked_items.zh: 检查了云凭据/基础设施枚举命令与钱包/助记词相关代码，均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked cloud credential/infrastructure enumeration commands and wallet/mnemonic-related code: none found.

evidence.zh: 插件用宿主凭据接口存储 IM 机器人凭据（控制器内 set/unset），不存在凭据回读；敏感文件路径读取未发现；网络外联端点为官方 IM 平台与用户自配的 AI Office HTTPS 端点，无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin stores IM bot credentials via the host credential interface (set/unset in controllers) with no credential read-back; no sensitive file path reads found; outbound network endpoints are official IM platforms and user-configured AI Office HTTPS endpoints, with no credential exfiltration channel.

Existing and newly created files are both valid."—no injection wording; compared to the previous version, the description adds a clarification "Existing and newly created files are both valid," semantics remain a file delivery instruction.

checked_items.en: Mechanical rule hit DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 with a total of 4 hits, adjudicated item by item: the spawnSync('dsh', ...) at bin/dsh-im.mjs:6 is a user-invoked install/uninstall CLI with a fixed binary and shell disabled; the execFileSync('/usr/bin/security', ...) at src/channels/feishu/config.mjs:1 reads the AppSecret from the macOS keychain with both binary and arguments fixed; the spawn(this.#dshBin, ['web', '--host', ..., '--port', ...]) at src/channels/shared/harness-client.mjs:1,720 automatically starts the local Harness service with arguments taken from its own config; the execFile at test/channels/feishu/lark-sdk-handshake-patch.test.mjs:2 exists only in test code. None provide a command injection or remote payload execution surface.

checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own web service or listens on ports (DSH-S03/DG-R6-51): no hits; the plugin registers channel handlers through the host-provided RPC surfaces (connection, credentials, webServer, typertGateway, see the injected list in plugin-src/host/index.mjs) and does not open its own service.

checked_items.en: WebSocket connections point only to official IM platform gateways (Discord Gateway, Slack Socket Mode, Feishu long connection, etc.) and the local Harness, with no anomalous endpoints. evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; the RPC surface is provided by the host; unauthenticated RPC on localhost is an inherent host-ecosystem risk, not a problem of this plugin.
